record.paper_title: Challenges of Symbolic Computation: My Favorite Open Problems
record.original_question: Find, besides mathematics education, another application area for symbolic computation that functions as a true 'killer application'—that is, an application whose demand makes the software written for it a commercial success.

evidence.quote:
Open Problem 8
Besides mathematics education, find another so-called "killer" application for sym￾bolic computation.

The problem is solved when the new application makes the software written for it a
commercial success.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A "killer application" for a class of software is an application domain whose user demand is large enough that software developed primarily for that domain becomes a commercial success. For symbolic computation software (computer algebra systems capable of exact manipulation of mathematical expressions, polynomials, integrals, differential equations, etc.), mathematics education is generally regarded as one such killer application.

Identify another application area, distinct from mathematics education, that serves as a killer application for symbolic computation. The problem is considered resolved by exhibiting a concrete application area together with symbolic-computation software developed for that area which has achieved commercial success driven by demand from that area.
artifact.status_search_result: This is an open-ended challenge problem about identifying a commercially successful application domain for computer algebra systems beyond mathematics education. No widely accepted resolution appears in the literature; the problem remains a subjective open challenge in the symbolic computation community.
